source: i-Tree MyTree (https://mytree.itreetools.org), run 2026-11-23/24 by browser automation
notes: Synthetic test trees only, entered as 'Testing/Imaginary Tree' (i-Tree EULA: inputs become public).
Condition Good, sun exposure Full, building proximity skipped, metric units, values 'Now' (this year).
seqC/storageC kg C, runoffL avoided runoff L/yr, interceptL rainfall intercepted L/yr, pollutants g/yr.
MyTree estimates height and crown from species and DBH; location data are canton-level.

Academy set: every tree species of the academy plant list (data/tree_size_classes_review.csv, no palms, no genus-only entries) at Rapperswil-Jona, DBH 25 cm (small trees 15 cm), large trees and conifers also 55 cm.
itreeName: name the species has in MyTree when it differs from the academy name.

Not in MyTree under any name (genus correction is used): Acer japonicum, Amelanchier lamarckii, Corylus avellana, Crataegus x lavallei, Cupressocyparis leylandii, Euonymus europaeus, Heptacodium miconioides, Laburnum x watereri, Magnolia liliiflora, Prunus laurocerasus, Prunus spinosa, Rhus typhina, Salix caprea, Styrax japonicus, Syringa vulgaris.
